title: Elizondo points AARO to a safe drawer that turns out empty

tellings.quote: but I know there was an episode uh like this with Lou Alzando where he told them of a particular location, an office, a safe a safe drawer, and the uh only to be told that when uh when they opened it up, there was nothing there.

plain: A former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo is said to have told AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UFO reports, about a particular office and "a safe drawer" where something was supposedly kept. When the drawer was opened, he was told, "there was nothing there." A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells Michels this as an episode he knows of second-hand, sometime in the 2020s. He brings it up to suggest that material can be moved before investigators get to it.
